note: What a server sends to lay out everything a champion brought to the match: the runes set before it began, its summoner slots, the choices made alongside them, and what its wards look like.

fields.name: runes
fields.note: The runes set before the match, thirty places in runs of nine, nine, nine and three. A place holds zero where nothing was set.

items.name: rune
items.note: One rune, by the number the client knows it as.

fields.name: summoners
fields.note: The spells in the champion's summoner slots.

fields.name: summonersAgain
fields.note: The same two spells a second time. A server writes them twice and both runs agree in everything observed.

fields.name: choices
fields.note: The choices made alongside them, one place each, and how far each was taken. A place stands empty where nothing was chosen.

fields.name: level
fields.note: The level the champion starts at.

fields.name: wardSkin
fields.note: What the champion's wards look like.
